description: Amivantamab with carboplatin and pemetrexed can be used during the managed access period as an option for untreated advanced non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) with activating EGFR exon 20 insertion (ex20ins) mutations in adults. It can only be used if the conditions in the managed access agreement for amivantamab with carboplatin and pemetrexed are followed.
